An average dinner experience
Feb 2025 • Friends
This is one of the western restaurants that was recommended by a local contact. The place itself is nice with broad variety of simple French bistro dishes. However, I would probably described it as a basic cooking style without much sophistication.

We ordered the escargot (but surprisingly they didn't have the special tongs), burrata, aubergine caviar and caesar salad as starters and the wagyu tenderloin and spring lamb rack (sharing portion) as mains. Burrata was nice (which didn't require any cooking skills) and I was told the wagyu was also very tender (as it should be but no pics as it wasn't my main course). However, the lamb was just so so and the meat was too chewy.

It has a nice garden area with large bench setting and the inside dining area has a homey feel.

Overall, it was a pleasant dinner with friends but more because of the company and chat.

Fabulous
Feb 2025 • Couples
What a wonderful restaurant. An interesting menu that offers such delights as escargots and oysters in the heart of Tay Ho, a comfy yet casual atmosphere, and excellent service. The homemade potato crisps are probably the best I've ever had (served warm) and my mushroom gnocchi was delicious, as was my husband's tuna steak -- all perfectly prepared and beautifully presented. Cousins is a winner.

A warm welcome and a menu which offers lots of choice
Dec 2024 • Couples
The menu contains dishes from a variety of European countries with France being the main country to hold the menu together. The wine list is similar with a decent selection of French wine complimented with wines from other European regions. We chose the Spanish Rioja which was not overpriced. It was a 2017 vintage and full of flavour.
The crème brûlée is just about as perfect as you can get it! 
The staff are very attentive .

Lovely dinner!
Aug 2024 • Friends
My husband and I are British but we have a home in France. I now am based in Hanoi and thus crave French cuisine. When he was visiting last month, friends suggested we try Cousins as I live only around the corner. Both he and I had fabulous steak and I had the cuises de grenouilles as an entree which was heavenly (although I did wonder why 3 rather than two pairs! HAHAH). Reasonably priced wine and one suggestion is that they ought to carry Heineken 0 for the teetotalers. We shall be sure to return! Merci a vous, Chez Cousins. A bientôt!
